claims_audited: V2 is a storage/computational refactor only and does not change the numerical/statistical contract.
V2 matches V1 numerically under the reported randomized validation harness.
V2 reduces prototype peak memory and build time under the reported tracemalloc stress harness.

observations.finding: The tracked validation artifact reports 30 randomized datasets with seed 20260829, max_abs_log_e_difference=0.0, max_abs_upper_endpoint_difference=0.0, and zero binary-counter invariant failures. Both versions used 40 root iterations and 50 endpoint iterations in that harness.
observations.scope: Worker-produced tracked validation artifact; not an independent external rerun.

observations.finding: V1 upper_endpoint rejects endpoint_iterations < 30 with ValueError('endpoint_iterations too small for fail-closed numerical use'). V2 removes that check and accepts the caller-supplied endpoint_iterations value, including values below 30.
observations.scope: Direct source comparison at the frozen note SHA.

observations.finding: The reported V1/V2 equivalence harness uses endpoint_iterations=50, so it does not exercise the low-iteration API region where O2 changes behavior.
observations.scope: Direct comparison of tracked validation configuration and source.

observations.finding: The tracked stress harness reports V1 peak 6,143,971 bytes versus V2 4,472,091 bytes (27.2117169823881% reduction) and V1 build 3.6388640800000758 s versus V2 2.8016687739999497 s (23.007050760744782% reduction) for n=3000, five lambda components under one local Python tracemalloc runtime.
observations.scope: Prototype local measurement only; no production latency/memory generalization.

observations.finding: V1 retains duplicate raw lower_items/upper_items alongside sorted hinge/suffix structures. V2 removes those duplicate tuple payloads and retains per-item threshold/value arrays plus suffix aggregates, which is consistent with the claimed storage optimization in the exercised path.
observations.scope: Source-level structural comparison; does not by itself prove all numerical contracts unchanged.

normal_configuration_v1_v2_equivalence.reason: Tracked randomized validation reports exact equality for the exercised 40-root/50-endpoint configuration.

storage_only_refactor_all_numerical_cont.reason: The fail-closed endpoint_iterations>=30 API guard exists in V1 and is absent in V2, so low-iteration caller behavior changed.

reported_memory_and_build_time_improveme.reason: The tracked local tracemalloc benchmark reports the stated reductions, but this is not a general performance guarantee.

statistical_validity_harm_from_removed_g.reason: This audit establishes a fail-closed numerical/API contract regression. It does not establish that the returned low-iteration endpoint is anti-conservative or invalid; no such stronger claim is made.

decision_relevance.correction: Do not describe V2 as a purely storage-only refactor with unchanged numerical contract. Limit equality claims to the validated configuration unless the minimum endpoint-iteration guard is restored or low-iteration behavior is separately specified and validated.
decision_relevance.o_admission_scope: If this candidate is considered downstream, preserve the local performance measurements and normal-configuration equality separately from the contradicted all-contracts-unchanged claim.

exact_next_action: Depth-convergence Batch B: inspect only current O_FEED entries marked accepted_for_o=true plus active contradiction keys, normalize their source-qualified task/artifact identities and tested scope, and do not reopen historical bulk replay unless a current source-qualified change reintroduces it.
